title: Inquest into Fatal Ammonia Inhalation at Continental Cold Storage
citation: Independent Contributor: Adv. Mihir Kothari (Bombay High Court) & Adv. Ananya Joshi (NLSIU Bangalore)
confidence_note: Inconclusive / Mixed Ambiguity - Dual causative factors: deferred corporate maintenance corrosion vs intentional mechanical wrench valve tampering. Standard of proof beyond reasonable doubt is NOT met.

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Corporate Management Negligence (Corrosion Cracking Flange Failure)
ground_truth.rationale: Metallurgical examination reveals severe stress corrosion cracking and 70% thread degradation across flange bolts that failed under normal operating pressure. However, toolmark impressions on secondary bypass valve indicate human tampering, creating irreducible statutory ambiguity.

hypotheses.label: Corporate Maintenance Negligence (Flange Corrosion Failure)
hypotheses.statement: Management deferred statutory hydrostatic inspections for 3 years, causing catastrophic ammonia rupture from stress corrosion cracking.

hypotheses.label: Competitor Industrial Sabotage (Deliberate Valve Tampering)
hypotheses.statement: An operative hired by rival export company entered through the perimeter fence and manually forced open the secondary pressure relief bypass valve.

hypotheses.label: Night Watchman Accidental Operation Error
hypotheses.statement: The deceased watchman attempted to silence a pressure alarm by turning valves without protective respirator gear.

exhibits.name: National Metallurgical Laboratory (NML) Flange Failure Report
exhibits.text: Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) of the failed ANSI Class 300 ammonia flange demonstrates extensive intergranular stress corrosion cracking (SCC) with 68% wall-thickness loss on the inner gasket seat, consistent with long-term deferred maintenance.

exhibits.name: State Directorate of Industrial Safety Inspection & Valve Toolmarks
exhibits.text: Forensic examination of the secondary bypass line discovered fresh serrated mechanical toolmark abrasions on the brass valve stem, indicating a 24-inch pipe wrench was applied to force the valve past its safety detent hours before the rupture. Paint flakes on the valve stem do not match in-house maintenance tools.

exhibits.name: CCTV DVR Hard Drive Diagnostic & Power Log
exhibits.text: Perimeter CCTV recorder experienced power disruption at 01:15 AM due to tripping of external breaker, leaving a 90-minute visual blind spot during which either internal passive failure or external intrusion could have occurred.
